title: tc-investment-balance
description:
Investment against priority: each tier's share of the items, the budget and the people, with over- and
under-invested tiers marked and the biggest mismatch said in one line.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

peopleUnit.description: The unit people are counted in: "FTE", "people"

currency.description: The budget's currency, an ISO 4217 code

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

threshold.description: How far, as a share from 0 to 1, a budget or people share may sit from the items share before it's marked

finding.description: The finding at the top, in place of the one worked out; an empty string hides it

selected.description: The selected tier's id. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

badge.description: A short mark before the name, e.g. "1" or "P1"

items.description: How many items (topics, projects) the tier holds

people.description: The people on the tier's work, in `people-unit`
